name: us10-mention
description: Mentioning an unclaimed issue key reads that ticket (content, acceptance criteria, priority, labels, status, flag, links, Confluence title+url, parent context, siblings — FR-050), stamps the spec's identity, updates only that ticket, and logs the mutation (FR-049). Both ports must emit a byte-identical --json summary, an identical Jira API call sequence (the read reads plus exactly one identity PUT), and an identical post-run tree (NFR-1).
